description: Dubai communities ranked by gross rental yield, computed from registered Ejari rent contracts against registered sale prices. Takes a minimum number of 12-month sales so a thin market cannot top the list.

limit.description: How many communities to return. Default 10, maximum 50.

min_sales_12m.description: Minimum registered home sales in the last 12 months. Default 300.

name: dubai_top_yields
title: Highest gross rental yields in Dubai
